interactions.description: returns the accepted HOBO-555 snapshop launch demo storyboard fixture

quickstartFixtureRefs.storyboardUse: scaffold scene uses accepted object-graph fixture ids and command transcript shape
local run scene reuses the accepted manifest collection fixture instead of inventing runtime behavior
plan scene reuses accepted plan preview fixture and proof-mode labels
live recording slot can claim live behavior only when manifest evidence is attached
inspect scene uses accepted projection evidence before layering freshness warnings
inspect scene shows stale and unknown evidence without promoting it to live proof
failure recovery scene cites accepted snapshot restore preview evidence without claiming production recovery
support handoff scene labels unsupported remediation and routes it to docs/support

storyboardSteps.title: Scaffold snapshop from the quickstart fixture
storyboardSteps.commandOrSurface: npx hobo new snapshop -t fullstack --fixture rlq-define-object-graph-v1
storyboardSteps.evidenceObject: terminal scaffold transcript with fixture id and generated file summary
storyboardSteps.safeClaim: Shows the command path shape for snapshop; it does not claim a shipped scaffold implementation.
storyboardSteps.supportDocsHandoff: Docs Portal can reuse the transcript with reference-fixture labeling.

storyboardSteps.title: Run snapshop locally through the simulated Camp
storyboardSteps.evidenceObject: local runtime activity screen with simulated service boundary markers
storyboardSteps.safeClaim: Shows local runtime behavior over mocked boundaries, not provider-hosted execution.
storyboardSteps.supportDocsHandoff: Tutorials can cite simulated local-run behavior and route failures to troubleshooting.

storyboardSteps.title: Inspect run evidence and freshness
storyboardSteps.evidenceObject: run inspector timeline with projection freshness and unknown-evidence markers
storyboardSteps.safeClaim: Shows the inspection evidence shape without implementing the inspector runtime.
storyboardSteps.supportDocsHandoff: Troubleshooting can link stale evidence to the support route and owner field.

storyboardSteps.title: Preview the deployment plan before launch
storyboardSteps.evidenceObject: plan diff with proof-mode chips, policy disposition, and safe next action
storyboardSteps.safeClaim: Demonstrates deterministic plan evidence and unsupported-state labels without provisioning.
storyboardSteps.supportDocsHandoff: Plan/Diff consumers can reuse the fixture id and must keep approval/provider work out of scope.

storyboardSteps.title: Reserve the live preview recording slot
storyboardSteps.evidenceObject: recording manifest slot requiring accepted live preview evidence before public use
storyboardSteps.owner: V1 Launch Site, Messaging & Demo Assets
storyboardSteps.safeClaim: Live proof can be claimed only when the recording manifest links accepted live behavior.
storyboardSteps.supportDocsHandoff: Launch Site consumes this as a placeholder until the manifest carries current evidence.

storyboardSteps.title: Preview snapshot restore recovery without overclaiming remediation
storyboardSteps.evidenceObject: rollback preview panel with snapshot restore evidence and production-recovery guardrails
storyboardSteps.safeClaim: Shows accepted recovery preview evidence without promising automated production restore.
storyboardSteps.supportDocsHandoff: Support Workflow receives the owner route, customer-safe recovery wording, and accepted limitation.

storyboardSteps.title: Hand off evidence to support and docs owners
storyboardSteps.commandOrSurface: support/docs handoff matrix for snapshop launch demo assets
storyboardSteps.evidenceObject: handoff matrix naming docs route, support owner, stale downgrade, and limitation text
storyboardSteps.owner: V1 Launch Site, Messaging & Demo Assets
storyboardSteps.safeClaim: Keeps launch-demo support and docs follow-up explicit before any public claim is published.
storyboardSteps.supportDocsHandoff: Docs Portal, Launch Site, Troubleshooting, and Support Workflow each get a target route.

assetMap.owner: V1 Launch Site, Messaging & Demo Assets
assetMap.refreshTrigger: Any screen, command wording, output, or proof-mode label changes.
assetMap.staleDowngrade: Downgrade to reference fixture until refreshed live screenshots exist.

assetMap.owner: V1 Launch Site, Messaging & Demo Assets
assetMap.refreshTrigger: Any live preview, expected output, simulated marker, or recording slot changes.
assetMap.validationRoute: recording manifest entry with freshness owner and accepted live evidence link
assetMap.staleDowngrade: Mark recording stale and block public live claims.

assetMap.refreshTrigger: Any command path, CLI wording, fixture output, or safe-claim boundary changes.
assetMap.validationRoute: checked-in transcript fixture cited by the storyboard proof note
assetMap.staleDowngrade: Keep transcript reference-only until quickstart fixture ids are refreshed.

assetMap.refreshTrigger: Any sample app, resource, manifest, failure, or recovery fixture changes.
assetMap.validationRoute: HOBO-577 quickstart parser and Pact-style fixture
assetMap.staleDowngrade: Reject downstream scenario updates that invent fixture ids.

assetMap.refreshTrigger: Any acceptance, owner, scope, proof mode, or public-claim boundary changes.
assetMap.validationRoute: design proof README plus docs freshness gate
assetMap.staleDowngrade: Route to known limitations and support wording before publication.

scenarioPaths.narrative: Evaluator scaffolds snapshop, runs locally, previews a plan, and reaches the live recording slot only when evidence exists.
scenarioPaths.accessibilityNote: Keyboard order follows command, evidence, owner, and proof-mode label before the next action.
scenarioPaths.supportHandoff: Docs owner receives transcript and fixture ids; launch owner receives recording slot.
scenarioPaths.safeOutcome: Demo can be rehearsed while live claims wait for recording-manifest evidence.

scenarioPaths.narrative: Missing auth, policy denial, unsupported provider, or can-deploy failure blocks the live slot and routes to recovery.
scenarioPaths.accessibilityNote: Blocked state uses clear text, visible focus target, contrast-safe severity, and no motion-only cue.
scenarioPaths.supportHandoff: Troubleshooting gets the denial evidence and customer-safe recovery wording.
scenarioPaths.safeOutcome: No live provider action is implied while blocked recovery remains scope-out.

scenarioPaths.narrative: Stale recording, unknown projection freshness, or missing fixture source downgrades the asset before publication.
scenarioPaths.accessibilityNote: Screen reader text announces stale evidence, owner route, and downgrade result.
scenarioPaths.supportHandoff: Launch owner refreshes the asset or docs owner marks the limitation.
scenarioPaths.safeOutcome: Stale assets cannot support public launch claims until refreshed.

scenarioPaths.narrative: Support and docs handoff keeps unsupported states explainable without claiming production recovery.
scenarioPaths.accessibilityNote: Responsive layout keeps owner, next action, and support route visible without truncation.
scenarioPaths.supportHandoff: Support Workflow receives limitation wording, escalation owner, and evidence source.
scenarioPaths.safeOutcome: Customer-safe support wording is available before any public demo publication.

accessibilityNotes: Keyboard navigation reaches each storyboard step, proof-mode chip, asset owner, and handoff route in reading order.
Screen reader labels name live, simulated, reference fixture, and scope-out modes without relying on color alone.
Contrast, responsive layout, and reduced motion are required for all launch-demo storyboard states.
